name: onestep-design
title_zh: 深海军蓝配暖灰的临床步态界面
tagline_zh: 做患者总览、跌倒风险面板、RTM 账单、周报这些屏，不用再猜色号字阶。颜色、圆角、间距、组件状态全按设计系统来。
tagline_en: Stop guessing hex codes for patient overview, fall-risk dashboards, RTM billing, weekly reports. Colors, radii.
desc_en: Build any UI, mockup or visual in OneStep's design system — clinical-grade gait/movement health products that blend navy authority with warm accessibility. Use this skill WHENEVER the user asks Claude to build, design, mock up, lay out, style or prototype anything for OneStep — product screens (patient overview, caseload roster, fall-risk dashboard, RTM billing, weekly report, walk summary, white-
why_zh: 不是贴图模板，而是把设计令牌（token）写进生成逻辑：深海军蓝传达临床权威，暖灰保可及性。
why_en: Not a sticker sheet — design tokens drive generation: navy for clinical authority, warm gray for accessibility, components.
limit_zh: 只认 OneStep 自家设计系统；非步态/运动健康类产品界面会硬套规范，产出像穿错制服。不接完整设计系统搭建。
limit_en: Only for OneStep's own design system; non-gait/movement-health UI gets force-fitted and looks off. Delivers single screens or components, not full.
title_en: OneStep clinical UI kit: navy + warm gray, spec-accurate
